title: Настя разоблачает Шефа  (Nastya Confronts the Chef)

segments.t: Outraged on Elena Pavlovna's behalf, Nastya confronts Chef Barinov outside the hotel room. When she hears a man's voice inside, Barinov claims they are secretly playing poker, but Nastya doesn't buy it and reaches for her phone.
А, так вы играете в покер.
Только не говори об этом Елене.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.

'How can you cheat on Elena?' Asking how Barinov cheat on Elena can cuts straight through the tension between Nastya and Barinov. Even in the middle of the drama, she keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
'Sorry, Chef, I gave you away.' Kostya tells Barinov that he gave Barinov away without dressing it up.
'I am in there with Elena Pavlovna.' Explaining that he is in there with Elena Pavlovna lays the cards on the table for Kostya.
'Kostya, let us go, we will not disturb them.' Here proposing that they go they will not disturb them sets up the next turn in their exchange.
'Is there another man in there with you?' Checking whether there another man in there with Barinov cuts straight through the tension between Nastya and Barinov.

'Chef, are you going to win it back today?' Asking whether Kostya going to win it back today is how Barinov puts Kostya on the spot. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
А, так вы играете в покер.

'Ah, so you are playing poker.' Explaining that Barinov is playing poker lays the cards on the table for Barinov. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
Только не говори об этом Елене.
'Just do not tell Elena about this.' Barinov mentions that just do not tell Elena about this so Kostya sees what is at stake.
'I promised that I would quit soon.' Claiming that he promised that he would quit soon sounds confident, even if Kostya has doubts.

'Then what woman ordered champagne?' With the call and conversation hanging in the air, Nastya puts Barinov on the spot. In Russian, she does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'We are leaving here, Kostik.' Nastya mentions that they are leaving here so Barinov sees what is at stake.

'I am calling Elena Pavlovna right now.' By being calling Elena Pavlovna right now, Nastya keeps her side of the story grounded. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
А, так вы играете в покер.
Только не говори об этом Елене.
To stop Nastya from calling Elena or the police, the chefs end up tying Kostya and Nastya up in the hotel room too. See you next time!
